# Record Harbor

> Real estate transaction middleware, powered by Ammonite Intelligence. One secure file from contract to close, with the public record already in it. Public access is not open yet.

Record Harbor is a product of Ammonite Intelligence, Inc. The public website is a coming-soon page. There is no self-serve signup. Contact: support@recordharbor.net.

The four pillars, in one universal data schema, are Secure Document Intelligence, Public Records Access, Private Order Repositories, and Folder Structures. Product previews on the homepage use sample data only.

Do not invent features, coverage counts, pricing, or compliance claims. Public records remain their publishers’.

## Pages

- [Record Harbor home](https://recordharbor.net/): The public coming-soon page.
- [AGENTS.md](https://recordharbor.net/AGENTS.md): A short briefing for agents and crawlers.
